# `list`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] list`

List files and directories in a path (dirs first, with sizes). Prefer this over shell `ls`. Optional recursive listing respects .gitignore and skips heavy dirs (target, node_modules, .git, …). Use `glob` for pattern search.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ignore` | array of string | no | Glob patterns to ignore (e.g. '*.o', 'tmp*') |
| `max_depth` | integer | no | Max recursion depth when recursive=true (default: 3) |
| `max_entries` | integer | no | Max entries to return (default: 200) |
| `path` | string | no | Directory path (relative to project root or absolute). Defaults to project root. |
| `recursive` | boolean | no | Recurse into subdirectories (default: false). Heavy dirs are pruned. |
